effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

corroboration.title: UDE official Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Rulings (capture 2005-06-16, inside the GOAT window)
corroboration.quote: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card's effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck Card Rulings, compiled April 6th 2010 (18 days before the Edison snapshot)
corroboration.quote: If you do not have "Commander Covington" in your Deck, your opponent can ask to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Storm of Ragnarok Card Rulings, compiled February 2 2011 - the latest positive attestation of the old state
corroboration.quote: If there is no longer a monster in your hand that you can Special Summon when this effect resolves, your opponent may briefly verify that this is the case.

changes.historical_text: If you Normal Summon this card, you must place it in face-down Defense Position. If this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, destroy the monster immediately with this card's effect without flipping it face-up or applying damage calculation. During the End Phase of a turn that this card destroyed a monster as a result of battle send this card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Mystic Swordsman LV6" from your hand or Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: if the End Phase effect resolves with no 'Mystic Swordsman LV6' in the hand or Deck, the goat script reveals both zones (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. The printed text never carried reveal wording.

changes.historical_text: If you Normal Summon this card, you must place it in face-down Defense Position. If this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, destroy the monster immediately with this card's effect without flipping it face-up or applying damage calculation. During the End Phase of a turn that this card destroyed a monster as a result of battle send this card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Mystic Swordsman LV6" from your hand or Deck.
changes.summary: Separate per-card era allowance: the goat sptg reduces to `ft>0` (written `ft>0 and true`) where the modern sptg also requires `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil,e,tp)`, so the period implementation lets the effect be activated and its cost paid - sending this card to the Graveyard - with no LV6 available to Summon. Nothing in the packet dates the end of that allowance for this card.

review.notes: As with LV2, the other script differences are verified non-behavioural: s.spcost matches the modern Cost.SelfToGrave (cardscripts/utility.lua:1434-1438), s.LVset=0x5f is SET_MYSTIC_SWORDSMAN's value, and RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD+RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END expands RESETS_STANDARD_PHASE_END (cardscripts/constant.lua:300). Text lineage v0 (SOD-EN012, 2004-10-01) -> v1 (SD5-EN014, 2005-11-02) -> v2 (DR3-EN012, 2006-11-25) -> v3 (LCYW-EN201, 2012-09-29) is cosmetic: 'If you Normal Summon this card, you must place it in face-down Defense Position' and 'Cannot be Normal Summoned (but can be Normal Set)' state the same Summon restriction, the damage-step destruction clause is PSCT-formalised without any script change, and 'this face-up card' adds no check in either script. Intermediate-state reasoning as for the other GoatConfirm cards: the two ruling transitions are unordered, no upstream implementation covers the state between them, and none is attached because GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) both precede 2011-02-02.
